featured_reviews.review_text:

Their behavior is rude and irresponsible, and once the payment is done, they completely change their attitude. This kind of wrong commitment and misleading behavior is unacceptable. Extremely disappointed and would advise others to stay away.
New Reply --

There is a big difference between the way you talk in person and the way you respond during phone discussions and reviews. As you told me earlier, you said that the vehicle would have to be left with you and that it would take 4–5 days. We were not ready for that because we cannot stop our work, as our daily income depends on the bike.
At that time, you did not give us any alternative option. Now you are saying that it will not even require one full day. This clearly shows a contradiction between what you say in person and what you say over the phone.
It feels like there is an attempt to mislead the customer in an easy way, which is completely wrong. In this situation, the loss is yours, not ours.
If one battery is not replaced, it will not affect us—we will manage somehow. However, in the future, the feedback for your services from our side will remain negative, because the impact will always reflect the way you treat your customers.
Thank you.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for your feedback. We regret that you feel disappointed; however, we would like to clarify the facts from our end.
Warranty Process: Battery replacement under warranty is possible only through the standard company warranty claim process, which requires vehicle inspection, job card and complete documentation.
Vehicle not left / Job card not completed: You and your brother were informed about the procedure, but the vehicle was not left at the workshop. Later, the battery was kept at the workshop without completing the job card and without submitting the required details, due to which the claim could not be processed.
Previous Exide Claim Rejection: We have also been informed that the same battery warranty claim was already submitted earlier at an authorised Exide warranty centre and was rejected as per company policy. This information was not disclosed to us at the time of interaction. Hence, we are unable to process the warranty claim again from our end.
Behaviour & Communication: During phone communication, our staff faced shouting and inappropriate language, including towards our female staff members. We request respectful communication. Such behaviour will not be tolerated.
We understand customer concerns, but we are bound to follow company procedures and maintain a safe and respectful workplace. We will be able to support only as per policy and proper process.
Thank you for your understanding.
— Pride Motors NX

He takes the time to understand your riding needs and works hard to fit things within your budget without pushing unnecessary upgrades.bought all my gear worth more than 28000 from here.

While the prices aren’t cheaper than the general market, the service, guidance, and after-sales support are impeccable, which honestly makes all the difference. You’re not just buying gear here..you’re buying peace of mind. The store also has a huge variety of gear, and if something specific isn’t available, there’s always the option to order exactly what you want based on your preference.

If you value honest advice, great support, and a wide range of quality biking gear, Moto Monks is absolutely worth checking out. Highly recommended for both new riders and seasoned bikers.
